item.title: Investors brace for Middle East war impact
item.description: The conflict in the Middle East has emerged as a major concern for investors, who fear a potential power struggle in Iran and a protracted regional war, with consequences rippling through global trade, energy markets, and inflation, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Iran after Khamenei: war, economic downturn, and risk of fragmentation
item.description: Even if the current government manages to withstand external military pressure from the United States and Israel - a prospect Rahmanifar views as uncertain - he believes domestic stability would remain elusive. “Even if the government defends itself against the U.S. and Israel, it will not be able to restore order. On the contrary, many people appear to be watching how far this war will go and may be waiting for an opportunity to resume protests,” he argued.

item.title: Drastic changes are unfolding in universe’s largest stars
item.description: The most massive stars in the universe are born brilliant, live fast by cosmic standards, and die young. In this sense, WOH G64 can be considered the stellar equivalent of Jimi Hendrix — dazzling, powerful, and destined for a dramatic finale, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Graffiti costs Germany millions annually
item.description: Last year, cases of vandalism targeting trains and railway infrastructure surged in Germany, with graffiti alone causing an estimated €12 million in damages annually, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azeri Light gains over 9% amid oil market rally
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude rose sharply at Italy’s Port of Augusta, increasing by $6.85, or 9.4 percent, compared to the previous figure to reach $79.60 per barrel on a CIF basis, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: US‑Israel strike campaign intensifies over Tehran as region braces for wider conflict
item.description: Israel has carried out a preemptive strike against Iran, AzerNEWS reports, citing Israeli media outlets.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev attends 12th Southern Gas Corridor Advisory Council Ministerial Meeting and 4th Green Energy Advisory Council Ministerial Meeting
item.description: The 12th Southern Gas Corridor Advisory Council Ministerial Meeting and the 4th Green Energy Advisory Council Ministerial Meeting have commenced at the Baku Convention Center, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan Cup enters decisive quarterfinal stage
item.description: The second-leg matches of the quarterfinal stage of the Azerbaijan Football Cup kick off on March 3, AzerNEWS reports. They set the stage for decisive battles in the race for a place in the semifinals.

item.title: Fitch affirms ratings of Southern Gas Corridor and seven EMEA infrastructure firms
item.description: Fitch Ratings has affirmed the ratings of Southern Gas Corridor CJSC (SGC) and seven other infrastructure companies operating across emerging markets in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), following an update to its corporate rating criteria, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: All 11 Iranian ships in Gulf of Oman clasims to have destroyed
item.description: US Central Command (CENTCOM) said Monday that all 11 Iranian vessels operating in the Gulf of Oman have been destroyed, AzerNEWS reports.
